svg.title: Dandelion Crown — step 4: Add one flower and repeat
svg.desc: Place a new flower beside the last one, with its stem underneath the growing bundle. Repeat the same wrap, then lay the tail alongside the other stems. Keep the heads close and curve the chain gently as it grows. Pause often to check its length around the top of the head.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Add another flower the same way

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One new flower, one wrap, then its tail joins the bundle.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep each new stem underneath first

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Curve the chain gently and check its length often.
